verdicts.reason: Both break the 'HOHOHO AGENCY' lockup and reverse the reading order, putting AGENCY above the subtitle and HOHOHO last. Both also leave the decorative shapes as a messy, colliding heap at the bottom. A has a cleaner subtitle break ('Office / Secret Santa') and more even spacing in the text stack, though its graphics are small and scattered. B leaves 'Santa' orphaned on its own line and jams the text block against the cramped tree icons at the top.
